gates.blocker: The complete build, test, privacy, and artifact pipeline must pass after the latest source change.
The live Process Tap watermark matrix must pass selected/nonselected, helper, restart, silence, device, permission, and cleanup cases.
Conditional journal evidence must remain visible until live device and physical storage boundaries are resolved.
A complete two-hour report is required; synthetic device events do not replace the remaining physical device matrix.
ADR-0003 and the technical design must match the digests and aggregate conclusion of all capture, timeline, journal, endurance, and worker evidence.
The unlocked-device Accessibility fixture must pass direct insertion, rejection, race, and clipboard fallback cases without a wrong-target write.
TextEdit, Chrome, Word, Outlook, rich-text, and Electron evidence passes; a controlled blank Terminal target still needs repeated success, latency, fallback, and side-effect evidence.
The XPC decision remains conditional until real-model, 16 GB, and signed-release measurements pass.
Pinned real runtimes and model digests passed a recommended-memory smoke; the full shared release corpus still needs a 16 GB minimum-support device plus thermal and long-session gates.

The recommended-memory synthetic four-input diarization/identity smoke passed; the 16 GB, authorized real-human device-lab/private-consented, release-holdout, correction-UX, license, and packaging matrices remain pending.
No default inference candidate may be selected before both ASR and speaker real-device release matrices, license reviews, and packaging gates pass.
Candidate registry, fixture artifacts, model digests, and ASR/LLM/resource reports must cross-reference exactly.
Every dangerous factual category must remain at zero errors.
Capture and journal must survive all resource-pressure scenarios.
Required usage descriptions and the minimal entitlement set must pass fail-closed linting.
Developer ID signing, notarization, stapling, and Gatekeeper require authorized release credentials.
Every packaged binary, model, resource, and digest must match the frozen release manifest.
App/model update tamper, interruption, downgrade, and rollback scenarios must all pass.
Repository-visible files must remain free of user content, secrets, and signing material.
PRD/threat/scenario/test/evidence references must resolve without missing evidence.
The five frozen MVP/V1 invariants must agree across requirements, design, ADRs, and code configuration.
